title: Second coordinate contraction for a coefficient of identity self symmetry
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, f:X→Y proper, W=X×_Y X with projections p1,p2, F=Rf*, and L∈D(Y_et,A) with canonical signed self symmetry swap(L,L)=identity. Let t:Ff*L→A_Y and t2:Rp2*p2*f*L→A_X satisfy exchange2(f*L), then Rp2*coordinate(L), then t2 = f*t followed by the canonical unit comparison. With the specified H, comparison, evaluation and coordinateH of [def-sfb-etale-coordinate-trace-data], for every K∈D(Y_et,A) one has comparison(HK), then H(evaluation(K)), equal to Rp2* of coordinateH tensor identity, then inverse orderedProjection(p2,HK,p2*f*L), then identity tensor t2, then the right unitor. No t1 or first-coordinate identity is assumed.

proof.text: Braidedness of the canonical pullback transports the identity self symmetry of L to f*L. Apply the single-factor base-change evaluation identity at K and the projection trace/tensor interchange identity to p2,f*K,f*L,t2. Naturality of the projection mate in its kernel moves coordinateH through projection. Precompose with the invertible ordinary p2 projection, cancel its inverse in comparison, combine the two tensor maps, substitute the base-change identity, then the tensor interchange. The projection naturality square gives exactly the requested right hand side. This combination is proved as a general category lemma so it does not unfold derived tensor instances.

lean.statement:
theorem secondCoordinateContraction [Finite A] {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (L : DerivedCategoryModule A Y)
    (hL : (swap A Y L L).hom = 𝟙 _)
    (t : (push A f).obj ((pull A f).obj L) ⟶ constantComplex A Y)
    (t2 : (push A (pullback.snd f f)).obj
        ((pull A (pullback.snd f f)).obj ((pull A f).obj L)) ⟶ constantComplex A X)
    (ht : (exchange2 A f ((pull A f).obj L)).hom ≫
        (push A (pullback.snd f f)).map (coordinate A f L).hom ≫ t2 =
      (pull A f).map t ≫ (leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).hom) :
    ∀ K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y,
        (comparison A f L ((H A f L).obj K)).hom ≫
            (H A f L).map
              (evaluation A f L t K) =
          (push A (pullback.snd f f)).map
              (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback f f)).map
                (coordinateH A f L K).hom).app
                  ((pull A (pullback.snd f f)).obj ((pull A f).obj L))) ≫
            (orderedProjectionIso A (pullback.snd f f) ((H A f L).obj K)
              ((pull A (pullback.snd f f)).obj ((pull A f).obj L))).inv ≫
                ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj
                  ((H A f L).obj K)).map t2 ≫
                  (derivedTensorRightUnitor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X
                    ((H A f L).obj K)).hom
